candidates.source_name: SEI-Net — Electronic information system for MSE-listed issuers (disclosure archive)
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory repository where listed MK banks (Komercijalna banka, Stopanska banka Bitola/Alta, TTK, Uni banka etc.) file annual reports, quarterly financials, shareholder-meeting materials and price-sensitive announcements. It is the durable archive of exactly the disclosures banks later remove from their own IR pages.
candidates.access_status: open (registration may be required for some document classes; site redesigned Oct 2024)
candidates.legal_status: mandatory public disclosure under MSE Listing Rules
candidates.suggested_collection_method: per-issuer document listing crawl; capture document metadata (issuer, date, type) plus PDF; cross-check against MSE issuer pages

candidates.source_name: Македонска берза (Macedonian Stock Exchange) — issuer pages and news archive
candidates.why_relevant: Per-issuer hubs link out to historical disclosure documents and carry a dated news archive; the authoritative index of which MK banks are listed and therefore have enforceable historical disclosure trails.

negative_findings.description: Searches did not surface any national web-archiving programme for the .mk domain (e.g. a National and University Library 'Св. Климент Охридски' web archive or an MK legal-deposit web harvest).
negative_findings.result_summary: No MK national web archive identified; Internet Archive appears to be the de facto archival layer for MK bank and regulator sites.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without a national harvest, historical MK bank disclosures survive only through Internet Archive coverage, which is thin for JS-heavy IR pages and PDF-behind-form assets — argues for our own proactive save-page-now programme.

negative_findings.description: The open-data portal was confirmed to exist (data.gov.mk / otvorenipodatoci.gov.mk) but searches returned no evidence of dedicated banking- or payments-sector datasets published there.
negative_findings.result_summary: Portal exists; banking/payments dataset coverage unconfirmed and likely sparse.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If the portal carries no financial-sector datasets, the reconstruction of time series must fall back on NBRM statistics and MAKStat rather than machine-readable open data.

negative_findings.description: No DSpace/EPrints-style open institutional repository for UKIM or other MK universities was identified; theses appear to be served as loose PDFs from faculty WordPress uploads instead.
negative_findings.result_summary: No harvestable OAI-PMH endpoint found for MK academic banking literature.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Academic material must be discovered by ad-hoc site crawling and search rather than metadata harvesting, raising collection cost and lowering recall.

negative_findings.description: NBRM's /WBStorage/Files/ and bank /content/pdf/ stores are reachable by deep link but no evidence was found that directory listings are enabled, so contents cannot be enumerated directly.
negative_findings.result_summary: Deep-link retrieval works; enumeration must come from Wayback CDX or site: queries.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Determines the collection method — CDX-driven URL discovery is mandatory rather than optional for these repositories.

negative_findings.description: No URL in this slice was fetched or liveness-tested; all entries are search-derived and awaiting the deterministic verification pass. Paywall/anti-bot flags are hypotheses based on each platform's known model, not observed responses.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream stages must not treat any status here as confirmed.

coverage_gaps.description: Per-issuer archival file stores were mapped only for Stopanska banka Skopje, NLB and Alta; the remaining MK banks (Komercijalna banka, Sparkasse, ProCredit, Halkbank, TTK, Uni banka, Silk Road, Centralna kooperativna, Development Bank of North Macedonia/МБПР) and savings houses have not had their PDF paths enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a per-domain Wayback CDX + site: PDF enumeration across the full NBRM list of licensed banks and savings houses, in both mk and en site variants.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival layer was mapped for the Комисија за хартии од вредност (Securities and Exchange Commission) or the Фонд за осигурување на депозити (Deposit Insurance Fund), both of which publish historical annual reports and decisions relevant to bank disclosure.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Dedicated mk-language pass on sec.gov.mk and fodsk.org.mk (or current domains) for report archives, then snapshot them.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival source was mapped for MK payments infrastructure operators (KIBS, CaSys, MIPS/MIPS-participant reporting), whose historical volume reporting is the backbone of any payments time series.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search kibs.mk / casys.com.mk plus NBRM payment-system oversight reports in mk, and Wayback-enumerate those domains.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language (sq) sources were out of the declared run languages (mk, en) and were not searched, although a substantial share of MK banking communication and academic work is published in Albanian.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: If the run scope can be widened, add sq queries (raporti vjetor, banka, pagesa) against MK bank and university domains.

coverage_gaps.description: No proactive archiving of currently-live MK IR pages has been established, so pages pruned between runs will be lost if Internet Archive has not independently captured them.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a save-page-now step to every collection run for all MK bank IR/press URLs touched, creating our own archival guarantee.

brief: For North Macedonia the archival layer rests on three pillars: the Internet Archive (the only general web archive covering .mk bank and regulator sites, since no national web-harvest programme surfaced), statutory repositories that outlive corporate websites (SEI-Net for listed-issuer disclosures, the Central Registry for annual accounts of unlisted banks and payment firms, and Службен весник for licences and regulatory acts), and durable PDF stores at NBRM (including the orphaned /WBStorage/Files/ legacy path) and at individual banks, whose deep file paths persist long after the pages linking to them are rebuilt. Continuous time series come from NBRM payment statistics and the State Statistical Office MAKStat database rather than from the open-data portal, which exists but shows no evidence of financial-sector datasets. The academic and think-tank layer is real but fragmented: RePEc indexes NBRM and Finance Think output with stable handles, while UKIM's Economic Institute journal and faculty thesis PDFs are open but only reachable by site crawling, with no OAI-PMH repository found. Priority next moves are per-bank Wayback CDX enumeration across the full licensed-bank list, coverage of the SEC and Deposit Insurance Fund, and the payments-infrastructure operators (KIBS, CaSys) which this pass did not reach.
